Application.Text10:
protocols:
id: P-MORPHOMETRY-CONTEXT
text: Observational microCT analysis context: 8.5 µm voxels, all later scans registered to baseline day 0 using rigid registration. Distal femoral and proximal tibial metaphyseal ROIs span 10% of bone length from the mineralized growth-plate interface toward the diaphysis. Cortical and trabecular compartments are analyzed separately. S1–S8 supply bone-,side-,animal-,time-specific 3D-Otsu thresholds; S9 defines normalized volumes/surfaces and apposition/resorption rates. Cortical pathological-patch method uses empirical noise and core criteria; Results reports the core threshold as 92%, whereas Methods states 92.61%. These are image-analysis criteria, not tissue-clearing conditions; no model-establishment operations are extracted.
